propositions: Add LLMRuntime auth capability class to accept provider-native pre-client auth/session inputs without serialization or caching
Extend PydanticAIRunner and get_runner to receive and pass LLMRuntime into the single per-run ProviderSession builder
Ensure provider-native auth reaches only the official Rebar-owned client lifecycle with no token extraction or alternate client construction
Reject absent or conflicting explicit auth before provider model requests without fallback to anonymous or cross-provider principals
Verify RP-01 authoritative behavior unchanged: one Agent operation, complete-or-omit retry history, budget/cache/exhaustion/artifacts/usage contracts intact
Secret credentials remain non-serializable and unwrap only inside provider builders, absent from config/request/snapshot/fingerprint/cache/schema/output/logs
